criterion_as_applied.rule: SIGNAL iff S1 and S2 hold and no failure clause holds; NULL otherwise (G in [0.05, 0.20) without S1 is NULL, recorded as weak). Controls must reproduce ATTAINABILITY.json or the outcome is INSTRUMENT_FAIL.

stupid_explanations_status.text: the cap: blocks that never converge are the heavy-noise ones, so t acts as a coarse failure flag rather than a slowing-down clock
stupid_explanations_status.how: secondary G with t -> 1[t=60]: mean 0.0219 vs full-t mean 0.0267 (ratio 0.82); cap fraction 0.793

stupid_explanations_status.text: the polynomial in s underfits E[w|s], and any second feature correlated with s (including t) absorbs the misfit and shows positive G
stupid_explanations_status.how: null twin (t from s alone, same shape) re-run in the same code path: mean G 0.0053; underfit absorption by an s-correlated feature is at most this

stupid_explanations_status.text: if the decoder were given p (a per-block LLR magnitude), t would leak p and hence w directly; the fixed LLR rule prevents this and must be kept
stupid_explanations_status.how: decoder uses fixed LLR +-1 for every block (world.py min_sum_iterations); p and w are never passed to it

stupid_explanations_status.text: t is discrete and saturates at 60, so G may sit on a plateau set by the cap rather than by the decoder dynamics
stupid_explanations_status.how: reported only: cap fractions (all/hi/lo) and the cap-indicator G; no run with a different cap (the cap is frozen), so a plateau set by the cap is not excluded
